notes: v3.10: Every menu now scrolls - drag or fling up/down with momentum and a scrollbar, buttons stay pinned, scrolling never presses anything. 60 new monsters (15 per element, small to ultimate) with their own specials that steal fury and new skills - find them under the New 3.10 tab in Summon, Versus and the Bestiary. Units now have their own sounds: summon cries, attacks, spells, hurt, death and footsteps that fit each creature and element, with a new Unit sounds volume slider in Options.
